share.doc: Public-safe preview facts for an External link (Secure share) token, used to draw the link card in chat. A public share (no email or password gate) returns its file name, filetype and sender, whether it has a content card, and for a folder the names of its first entries; a gated share returns only state secure; a revoked, expired or unknown token returns state unavailable. Never returns hub ids, node ids, emails or gate details.

token.doc: Secure share token, the last segment of the External link

filename.doc: Shared file or folder name. public only

sender.doc: Full name of the person who created the link. public only

card.doc: The shared file has a content card (link_preview.card). public only

items.doc: First entry names of a shared folder. public folder only

more.doc: The folder has more entries than items. public folder only

card.doc: Preview image of an External link (Secure share) for link-preview crawlers: the 460x260 content card of a PUBLIC shared image, video or document. Any other token (gated, revoked, expired, unknown, a folder, a file without a card) is redirected to the generic public card image of the UI build.

token.doc: Secure share token, the last segment of the External link

image.doc: PNG content card, or a 302 to the generic card image
